name: create_visitor_analytics_tables
query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.visitor_sessions (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, session_token varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, visitor_id varchar(255) NOT NULL, ip_address varchar(45) NULL, user_agent text NULL, locale varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ar', duration_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, page_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, intent_score integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, metadata jsonb NULL, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), last_active_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), created_at timestamptz NULL, updated_at timestamptz NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS visitor_sessions_visitor_id_index ON public.visitor_sessions (visitor_id); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.visitor_events (id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, visitor_session_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES public.visitor_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, event_type varchar(255) NOT NULL, page_path varchar(255) NOT NULL, properties jsonb NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS visitor_events_event_type_index ON public.visitor_events (event_type); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS visitor_events_visitor_session_id_index ON public.visitor_events (visitor_session_id);
